labels.name: find_map
labels.description: Find maps by place or region name, e.g. "Texas", "Japan", "Ontario", "Cook County", "Europe". Matches map titles and the names of every region inside each map, and returns the matching maps (free first) with the regions that matched.

labels.name: get_free_map
labels.description: Returns the SVG source of one free map (blank world, blank US states, blank US counties, blank maps of countries and continents, labelled Switzerland cantons) with its region names. Every region is one <path> with id and data-name, ready to recolour as a choropleth. Free for any use. Pass id from li
